features.title: 🚀 Merchant can view settlement status in merchant dashboard
features.body:
## User Stories

### Story: Merchant sees settlement status in the dashboard
As a Merchant, I want to see settlement status in the merchant dashboard, so that I can track payouts without contacting support.

```gherkin
Scenario: Settlement status shown in the merchant dashboard
  Given a Merchant has settlements
  When the Merchant opens the merchant dashboard
  Then each settlement shows its settlement status
```

## Trace Plan

1. [ ] ☄️ Skeleton — Merchant sees settlement status in the merchant dashboard (claims: "Settlement status shown in the merchant dashboard")
